title: Skip already-forwarded items in the ingest worker
body:
**What**

Adds a small seen-ids checkpoint file to the ingest worker, so a restart does not resend items that were already forwarded downstream.

**Why**

The sink is not idempotent, and a redeploy mid-poll caused duplicate reports upstream last week. A checkpoint lets the worker pick up where it left off instead of resending everything since the beginning.
